reviews.text: It was a very pleasant visit took 3 dogs for Rabies and well checks and medicine for a slight ear infection for one of them. The staff. Was wonderful., and pleasant. The Vet Doc was absolutely professional and communicated very well and honest . The visit costed abit over $300.00+ . I thought it   was reasonable especially for 3 dogs 2 over 70lbs and one 50lbs. And my dogs all. Behaved so awesome and loved the vibe there. Thank you to everyone there!. We are making them out regular vet for checks . And to neuter our 2 boys that are over 70lbs but under 80lbs the cost is going to be just over 750.00 that's about average from the research I've done , when you can't get a voucher or assistance. The only thing that is a bummer is they don't take care credit but they do take debit and credit cards. Anyways overall very happy with it. I

Dr Reynolds has seen two of our cats and one of our dogs (so far) and has been wonderful to work with.  The staff is great, pricing is much more reasonable than the chain vet we went to previously, and our animals are doing well.  We will continue to bring our pets to Dr Reynolds and her team.
Great staff and high quality care for my emergency senior cat! Much appreciated! Highly recommend.

Great vet. Personable. Reasonably priced
No overselling. Easy to get appointments

We had such a wonderful experience with Amherst Plaza Animal Clinic. Our cat Dander recently needed a dental procedure and oral surgery and we couldn’t have asked for better care.  Dr.  Reynolds was incredibly knowledgeable, thorough and compassionate and we felt confident knowing our fur baby was in such capable hands.

The entire staff was friendly, caring, and professional from start to finish.  They took the time to answer our questions, kept us informed and treated our cat with so much kindness and patience. If you’re looking for a great veterinarian, look no further!
Thank you!
Dr. Reynolds is the Best. We have been going to her for years. Give Amherst a try, you won’t be disappointed.

This place is great.  Great care for my cats and they get me in fast.  She takes the time to talk and explain things clearly.  She offers treatment options and the pricing is always fair.  Im do glad i foynd tjis place!

We have been going to Amherst since their opening on Greenway and 35th Ave., and Dr Lapardo since 1991. That being said the new Vet is doing awesome. She is kind, thorough and very communicative. We took our new dane and our Saint Bernard and the office is squeaky clean with nice upgrades. We will continue with Amherst- - big smileys

Very caring to my dogs...
Thank you
Super friendly and just as affordable, they got my dog in last minute for x rays on a Saturday!
Excellent, friendly, fast service. The staff and Dr. Reynolds are always polite and helpful. Highly recommend for any of your pet care needs.

HONEST AND CLEAN! They didn't charge me a penny more than necessary for my dogs dental and extractions. They told me how everything went without bs. Its hard to find a good trustworthy Vet these days and unfortunately the good ones are few and far between. This clinic is AWESOME!
-Update, Willow is doing great after her dental extractions and they called just to check on her within a week.
First visit to this clinic. Staff was super friendly and doctor took her time with us and provided us options. Very thrilled to have an established vet!

Quick appointment availability. Older building. The vet tech and veterinarian were both kind and knowledgeable. My dog was well taken care of. The receptionist seemed a little less thrilled with her job. Overall it was a good experience and I would go back again.

Over the moon with our experience here at Amherst animal clinic. Our dog is usually an absolute mess at the vet…. A challenging girl to say the least and all of the staff was patient and kind throughout our visit. We are very happy that we decided to change vets!
Very caring, would highly recommend to anyone.

Very friendly, No automatic phone system. They just answered. Got us in the same day for the rabies shot. Very quick as well.

Definitely are new vet. Prices were cheaper then other places as well
Dr Lapardo is the absolute best hands down.
Dr. Rhonda, and her staff, treat me and my critters like family.  What more could you ask for.
I have been taking my pets to Amherst for many years, always get great quality care, Dr. Lapardo is amazing.
Dr Lepardo has been my veterinarian for many years. I have the utmost respect for her and her vet care.
We absolutely love Amherst. The staff is amazing and very caring during the stressful moments of being a pet parent. I would highly recommend Amherst for your veterinary needs.
The best vet and staff. That's why we (my self and furry friends) have been coming here for years.
They're not taking any new patients? A cat only needs to be fixed once people. How many patients do you possibly have?

Too busy for new clients! Called this vet facility to schedule an appointment based on a referral. Tried to schedule an appointment for our new puppy for check up and 16 week vaccinations. They put me on hold then a Jacqueline got on the line and told me unfortunately we are not taking new clients. She was short and rude. No explanation or recommendation to another vet or facility. Not a good start for customer service. They could have had a long term customer. We will take our English Bulldog puppy to a more respectful veterinarian facility.
